The 0.5.x names, kept as aliases

Source: R/compat_names.R
rmbl-aliases.Rd

Every function rmoriebricklayer 0.5.13 exported that 1.0.0 renamed is still callable by its old name, with its old argument names: each alias forwards to the new function. The reference documentation lives on the new name; this page only lists the aliases.
